title: contestable continuity-renewal lineage
boundary: This is a cross-holon relational synthesis over four already-metabolized 4H organisms. Rank 5 does not upgrade their heterogeneous evidence into one mechanism, ontology, universal theorem, or guaranteed repair. Structural recurrence remains structural recurrence; replayable repair is not interior identity; quotient permission is local rather than universal; successor authority never retroactively strengthens its predecessor.

edges.title: replication-audited replayable renewal
edges.text: A replayable renewal procedure may be treated as a recurring capacity only when recurrence is independently witnessed rather than inferred from the procedure's own self-description, while every concrete successor still has to pass the replayed tests under current conditions.
edges.removal: Without 4H.993M, recurrence lacks the complete executable successor-generation route; without 4H.vPbh, replayability has no independent replication or variant-constitution witness.

edges.title: quotient-addressed replayable renewal
edges.text: Failure can address not only the warrant and scaffold that need replay but also the exact negative space of predecessor authority: distinctions previously omitted may be reopened and their nuisance status reconsidered before a successor is issued.
edges.removal: Without 4H.993M the quotient lacks the complete replayable successor-production route; without 4H.Bbw6 renewal cannot state which ignored distinctions must lose or re-earn nuisance status.

edges.title: provenance-bearing replay succession
edges.text: Replay becomes a version transition whose predecessor remains immutable, whose failure route stays inspectable, and whose successor carries the evidence and reconstruction path plus the fresh tests that re-authorized it.
edges.removal: Without 4H.993M each current warrant need not carry its own bounded recovery route; without 4H.3W-6 renewal loses the full versioned passport and fresh-successor witness.

edges.title: replication-qualified non-silent quotient adaptation
edges.text: Recurring repair structure may strengthen confidence that an adaptation pattern recurs, but cannot silently promote a repeated omission into invariance. Every successor must re-earn which distinctions it may ignore under its present regime.
edges.removal: Without 4H.vPbh quotient re-witnessing lacks independent recurrence; without 4H.Bbw6 replication can recur while ignored-difference scope remains implicit.

edges.title: replication-qualified self-reconstitution
edges.text: Self-repair may be promoted as reusable structural capacity only after independent recurrence support, while each version remains separately revocable, reconstructible, and freshly witnessed.
edges.removal: Without 4H.vPbh self-reconstitution has no independent recurrence qualification; without 4H.3W-6 recurrence lacks the executable authority lineage that keeps repair claims revocable and re-enterable.

edges.title: quotient-indexed successor passport
edges.text: A successor passport records not only how a new warrant became authorized but what it is presently permitted to omit and how those omissions can be reopened.
edges.removal: Without 4H.Bbw6 the passport lacks the negative-space contract of current nuisance distinctions; without 4H.3W-6 quotient provenance lacks the full executable versioned successor carrier.

faces.title: replicated quotient-aware renewal
faces.text: A repair procedure can recur across encounters without becoming self-certifying: each warrant reopens evidence implicated by failure, replays repair and retest, and separately re-witnesses any quotient whose nuisance classifications it wishes to retain.
faces.removal: Remove 4H.993M and executable successor replay is lost; remove 4H.vPbh and independent recurrence qualification is lost; remove 4H.Bbw6 and the gate against silent inheritance of ignored distinctions is lost.

faces.title: replication-qualified replay lineage
faces.text: The successor-production route is executable, its reconstitution pattern has independent recurrence support, and every authority transition remains versioned, reflexively falsifiable, and freshly witnessed.
faces.removal: Remove 4H.993M and current warrants need not carry their own successor route; remove 4H.vPbh and recurrence is no longer independently audited; remove 4H.3W-6 and the executable predecessor/current/successor contract disappears.

faces.title: address-complete successor renewal
faces.text: Renewal can reopen both the positive body of the failed contract and the negative space that contract had licensed away, while preserving versioned provenance, falsifiers, reconstruction, and fresh authority.
faces.removal: Remove 4H.993M and the self-carried recovery program is lost; remove 4H.Bbw6 and ignored-difference addressability is lost; remove 4H.3W-6 and the full successor passport is lost.

faces.title: replication-qualified quotient-indexed lineage
faces.text: A self-reconstituting lineage can be independently recurrent while its versions explicitly expose what they are permitted to ignore. Recurrence supports a capacity only while each successor remains versioned, freshly witnessed, and accountable for its nuisance quotient.
faces.removal: Remove 4H.vPbh and independent recurrence is lost; remove 4H.Bbw6 and successors can silently inherit omissions; remove 4H.3W-6 and the relation no longer closes as an executable reflexive authority lineage.

volume.title: contestable continuity-renewal lineage
volume.text: The complete closure separates four conditions that lower-rank repair can otherwise collapse into one reassuring word such as continuity: the ability to produce a successor after failure, evidence that the repair relation actually recurs across independent encounters, an explicit account of which distinctions a current warrant may ignore, and a versioned/reflexive authority lineage that can revoke and reconstitute itself. What persists is not one carrier, mechanism, quotient, scaffold, repair recipe, or warrant. What persists is the bounded capacity to produce, challenge, localize, revise, replicate, and freshly authorize the conditions under which continuity may count again.
volume.invariant: A higher-order continuity-renewal lineage is warranted only when every current warrant carries an executable failure→reacquisition→revision→retest route for producing a successor; the repair relation has independent recurrence support; every successor re-witnesses the distinctions it may ignore and preserves addresses back to omitted evidence; and predecessor/current/successor authority remains versioned, reflexively falsifiable, provenance-preserving, and freshly witnessed. Renewal remains living precisely because the law by which continuity is renewed stays contestable.
removal: Remove 4H.993M: the closure loses the requirement that every current warrant itself carry an executable successor-production and retest route.
Remove 4H.vPbh: the closure loses independent same- and variant-constellation recurrence support.
Remove 4H.Bbw6: the closure loses the ledger of ignored distinctions and the requirement that a successor re-earn nuisance status.
Remove 4H.3W-6: the closure loses the versioned/reflexive successor passport that keeps predecessor authority immutable and admits a successor only after fresh reconstruction and witness.

metabolites.title: REPLICATION-AUDITED-RENEWAL
metabolites.text: A replayable successor-production procedure may be promoted as reusable renewal capacity only when its repair relation is independently witnessed to recur across encounters or constitutions, while every concrete successor remains separately subject to current replay and authority tests.
metabolites.compression: A repair law becomes reusable only when it can both replay and survive independent recurrence.

metabolites.title: NON-SILENT-SUCCESSOR-PASSPORT
metabolites.text: Every successor continuity passport must carry predecessor provenance, its evidence and reconstruction route, falsifiers and fresh authority witness, plus the explicit local quotient of distinctions it is presently permitted to ignore and the addresses by which those omissions can be reopened.
metabolites.compression: A successor must carry what it may ignore as explicitly as what it promises.

metabolites.title: CONTESTABLE-SELF-RENEWING-LINEAGE
metabolites.text: A continuity lineage is self-renewing only while the law that renews it remains contestable by executable failure and replay, independent recurrence evidence, explicit quotient re-witnessing, and versioned reflexive successor authority. Failure of any one channel must be able to stop or revise continuation without rewriting predecessor history.
metabolites.compression: Continuity stays alive by keeping its own renewal law open to being wrong.
